title: Peruviankkit
description: A nice survival multiplayer Spanish Peruvian server
body:
▶️ | Peruviankkit Network | ◀️


IP: play.peruviankkit.net

![Peruviankkit Lobby](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pkg01Q0C/images/00e42f572bb408c80ad86de99424d4f6d50d2c31.png)

We are a Spanish Peruvian server with more than 10 years of history.

We have Survival Vanilla 1.21.11 and many mini-games.

![Peruviankkit Survival Spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pkg01Q0C/images/5164c877986b84eabb40a3b920d199c0cc7e1636.png)

Visit the Survival, Nether, and End worlds, build your base, and battle other players and mobs.

![Peruviankkit Nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/pkg01Q0C/images/0839579298e946f18dd1d5a02098cfb657257e08.png)

Recommended version 1.21.11, but you can log in from 1.21.6 onwards.
